original: अत्रैष देवः स्वप्ने महिमानमनुभवति । यद्दृष्टं दृष्टमनुपश्यति श्रुतं श्रुतमेवार्थमनुशृणोति देशदिगन्तरैश्च प्रत्यनुभूतं पुनः पुनः प्रत्यनुभवति ॥ १ ॥
transliteration: atraiṣa devaḥ svapne mahimānam-anubhavati | yad-dṛṣṭaṃ dṛṣṭam-anupaśyati śrutaṃ śrutam-evārtham-anuśṛṇoti deśadigantaraiśca pratyanubhūtaṃ punaḥ punaḥ pratyanubhavati || 1 ||
translation: There, in the dream state, this luminous deity (the mind) experiences its own majesty. Whatever has been seen it sees again; whatever has been heard it hears again; and whatever has been experienced in different lands and directions it experiences again and again.
meaning: The creative architecture of the dream state: When physical senses rest, the mind shines in its own self-projected light, synthesizing past memories and experiences into vivid virtual realities.

adi-shankara.en: [Adi Shankaracharya] In dreams, the external senses are withdrawn into the mind. The mind, illumined by the witness consciousness, becomes both creator and experiencer of its internal universe.
adi-shankara.hi: [आदि शंकराचार्य] स्वप्नावस्था में बाह्य इन्द्रियाँ मन में विलीन हो जाती हैं। मन अपने संस्कारों की सामग्री से स्वयं सृष्टि की रचना कर उसका अनुभव करता है।
adi-shankara.mr: [आद्य शंकराचार्य] स्वप्नात बाह्य जगाचा संपर्क तुटतो आणि मन आपल्या पूर्वसंस्कारांमधून स्वतःचे काल्पनिक जग निर्माण करून त्याचा आनंद घेते.

universal-synthesis.en: [Universal Vedic Synthesis] Ancient cognitive neurology and dream psychology: the subjective mind constructs internal sensory environments from stored neuro-cognitive impressions.
universal-synthesis.hi: [सार्वभौमिक वैदिक समन्वय] स्वप्न विज्ञान और अवचेतन मन की कार्यप्रणाली का यह सटीक विश्लेषण आधुनिक मनोविज्ञान का मार्गदर्शक है।
universal-synthesis.mr: [सार्वभौम वैदिक समन्वय] सुप्त मन कसे भूतकाळातील अनुभवांचे पुनरुत्थान करते याचे हे अत्यंत सूक्ष्म आणि वैज्ञानिक वर्णन आहे.
